Glock Stock 2.info: A Grand Federation-made stock which folds over in front of your G-Series pistol. Reduces rotational recoil while increasing camera recoil.

MP5K Stock.info: Specially made stock for the SMX-9K. Reduces rotational recoil while increasing camera recoil.

Glock Stock Folded.info: A Grand Federation-made stock which you have folded over in front of your G-Series pistol. Now you have a foregrip! Featuring similar attributes to the Angled Grip.

Full Stock 3.info:
An extended stock, providing a better firing position.

Improves kick damper, kick speed, and general recoil. Reduces aim speed, maneuverability, and hipfire stability.

Braced Stock.info: A braced stock with an ergonomic design that makes it faster to aim down the sights, while also improving gun sway while moving and while aiming down the sights. This stock also improves breath time on scopes and scope sway.

Remove Stock.info:
Remove the weapon's stock for better mobility and handling speed.
Significant recoil and weapon sway increase, but excellent handling improvements across the board.

Extended Stock (ALT).info: Fold out the weapon's stock for greater stability.

Police Stock.info: What's a sheriff without his deputy? This stock will be at your side to through the best and worst times. Treat it with respect.

AK-308 Gen 4 Stock.info:
Gen 4 Stock Aesthetic.

Improved recoil management, but slightly increase aim and sprint transition times.

Boom Stock.info: Reinstalls the stock to your SAWED-OFF, improving camera kick recovery and reducing overall aimed kick.

DT Sporting Stock.info: A sturdy stock found on the DT11 ACS. It will certainly aid in recoil control for any situation, but the weight may become a hinderance for movement.

MGV176 Folded.info: Folds your stock. Adds to your vertical and horizontal recoil by 30%.

Magazine Stock.info: Do away with a conventional weapon stock, the PP-2000 has a space for you to place your spare magazines! Increased reserve count, but expect less stability.

Full Stock 2.info:
A sturdier stock to help mitigate recoil.

Significantly improves how much the gun kicks backward when firing.
Somewhat improves general gun kick.
Improved scope breath time and breath recovery.
Worse handling and slightly longer reload times.

KAC Stock.info:
The R SQUARED stock taken off and placed onto the RH-44.
Greater recoil control, worse maneuverability and hipfire control. Equips slower.

Glock Stock.info: An Eretz-Kedem stock for the G-series pistols. Reduces rotational recoil while increasing camera recoil.

Taurus Stock.info:
The Taurus carbine kit stock placed onto your revovler.
Greater recoil control, worse maneuverability and hipfire control. Equips slower.

Retract Stock.info:
Fold in the weapon's stock for better mobility and handling speed.
Significant recoil and weapon sway increase, but excellent handling improvements across the board.

MC51SD Stock.info: STG-89C's stock now extended out. Reduces recoil while reducing mobility and hipfire stability.

DT Olympian Stock.info: Adjustable stock found on the DT11 PRO. It will certainly cushion the recoil but you will not lose out on mobility. However aiming is slower.

Obrez Stock.info: Reattach the stock to the OBREZ in order to decrease the recoil kick, at the cost of some other areas.

SCAR TRS Stock.info:
A special TPR stock for the SOCOM rifle family.
Sturdy stock perfect for combat in trying times.
Improves kick damper, kick speed, and general recoil. Reduces aim speed, maneuverability, and hipfire stability.

Light Stock.info:
A lighter alternative over the default stock.
Improves mobility and handling speed but increases recoil due to missing recoil buffer parts. Increases weapon sway when scoping and walking.

HK51B Stock.info: Extend out the MG89B. Generally reduces recoil with mobility drawbacks.
